title: Monthly Energy Review
summary: (Tue, 29 Sep 2026) The Monthly Energy Review is our comprehensive report on recent and historical energy statistics. According to our September 2026 report, preliminary estimates indicate that U.S. total primary energy production equaled 54 quadrillion British thermal units (quads) in the first six months of 2026, a 3% increase from the same period in 2025. U.S. total primary energy consumption equaled 48 quads in the first six months of 2026, a 1% decrease from the same period in 2025.
